annotations.comment: SSM P48 / parameter003C: native258C encodes C8C8 actual bank0 cam angle with scale1 and bias-50; display byte-50 degrees. Bank0 matches upstream Right label. Capability14 at7BDB3 supports this callback. Verified native callback and complete AVCS profile exchange on main/v2/captured. AVCSREPAIR1 20260913 records Right=0 in all268 moving/pedal>=30/RPM2500..3500 samples while Bank0 C91C output and P52 B098 current are nonzero in most. C8C8 is post-learned-offset/clamped; targets, raw capture and offset8264 are unlogged. This is not proof of a stuck physical solenoid or the cause of the persisting cut.

Native spark inhibit publisher: CD50/80 or CE28/01 forces C0DC=FFFF; otherwise six D94C/D94D configured bits map into duplicated12-slot masks. Independent of injector word B744. Existing ignition permission/device native tests cover this path. AVCSREPAIR1 20260913 records B744=0 during the user-confirmed loaded cut, but does not log C0DC/C0E1/C290 or coil timer outputs; no hardware-firing conclusion follows from B744 or P10 alone.

Native stopped/timeout ignition-mode reset. 1A256 reads B52C/80; when set this routine writes C0E1=0 and C0E3|40, and updates C0E2/80 from 7B27A and coolant75FF0. Read back from stock via MCP 20260913; caller117E4 remains stock in repairedv2. B52C/80 is published from AC0C by1A16E and cleared by19F9C. 2716C is the separate phase-task running-mode update. These states are not in AVCSREPAIR1; do not infer this reset occurred from the loaded cut.
